== Notes ==
*Removes all enchantments any time the well is entered.
*Foes in this well cannot be targeted by [[Enchantment spell#Characteristics|enchantment spells that target a foe]], like [[Ice Spear]].

{{anomaly|Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments; however, untargeted enchantments still work, which includes all [[flash enchantment spell]]s, and spells like [[Shadow Refuge]]. These enchantments don’t get stripped simply by being inside the well, but only each time the well is entered. If one manages to gain an enchantment while inside (i.e. [[Aegis]], [[Orders]], etc.), it is not removed. [https://forum.guildwars.com/forum/forums/gamebugs/Well-of-the-Profane/ Source.]}}
